study_strategy.warning: Both are spiny Apiaceae and can look 'thistle-like.' Leaf architecture is the fastest split.

quick_split: E. leavenworthii — annual; upper plant often purple; broad deeply divided spiny leaves; elongated heads with a conspicuous bract crown.
E. yuccifolium — perennial; long linear yucca-like leaves; pale globose heads; no purple bract crown.
comparison_lesson.caveat: E. yuccifolium remains a range HOLD in this project until a third exact target-zone county is locked.
